view: Shangdu Xanadu archaeological grassland panorama from modest raised earthen bank, low rectangular grass-covered wall lines and a few exposed grey foundation stones under broad pale sky, rolling Mongolian steppe horizon; no standing palaces, no fantasy golden pavilions or tent city.

eras.title: A capital traced in grass
eras.caption: At Shangdu, low banks and foundations mark the plan of Kublai Khan's summer capital. Open grassland now stretches across spaces once divided by palace courts, city walls and streets, preserving the outline more clearly than the buildings themselves.
